scope: Saved historical ledgers only; no fitting, source/config alteration, reserve observations, resimulation, winner selection or promotion

continuing_strategy_measurement.NAV: Set measurement NAV to 1 immediately before the first included return; compound the existing saved net daily returns without resetting the strategy.
continuing_strategy_measurement.carry_in: Prior ledger NAV, shares, cash fraction and exposure are reported. The first included daily return retains overnight movement, original trades and actual costs.
continuing_strategy_measurement.boundaries: No fresh initial allocation or artificial liquidation at year/subperiod boundaries. Existing final liquidation at the original 2023 endpoint remains included.
continuing_strategy_measurement.fees: Raw fees retain original-account NAV-1 currency. fees_per_window_start_NAV divides those recorded fees by actual prior-session account NAV; it is a measurement normalization, not a recomputed execution cost or return drag.
continuing_strategy_measurement.drawdown: Window drawdown resets only the measurement high-water mark to initial normalized NAV 1; it does not alter source positions or trades.
continuing_strategy_measurement.Sharpe: sqrt(252)*mean(existing net simple daily return)/sample std(ddof=1), zero risk-free/cash convention.
continuing_strategy_measurement.tail: Worst daily return, empirical 5th percentile and mean of the worst ceil(5%*n) daily returns. The latter is reported as a signed daily-return CVaR/expected-shortfall estimate; no independent-sample or tail-model claim.

findings: baseline: common-period net Sharpe exceeds v3 baseline in 0/15 separate ETF accounts and causal always-long vol reference in 6/15. 0/15 show positive delta versus baseline in both early and late subperiods. These are descriptive counts, not promotions or significance claims.

payoff_only: common-period net Sharpe exceeds v3 baseline in 6/15 separate ETF accounts and causal always-long vol reference in 4/15. 1/15 show positive delta versus baseline in both early and late subperiods. These are descriptive counts, not promotions or significance claims.

context_only: common-period net Sharpe exceeds v3 baseline in 6/15 separate ETF accounts and causal always-long vol reference in 5/15. 2/15 show positive delta versus baseline in both early and late subperiods. These are descriptive counts, not promotions or significance claims.

payoff_context: common-period net Sharpe exceeds v3 baseline in 9/15 separate ETF accounts and causal always-long vol reference in 3/15. 3/15 show positive delta versus baseline in both early and late subperiods. These are descriptive counts, not promotions or significance claims.
limitations: All pre-2024 history is exploratory and repeatedly inspected; subperiods are stability diagnostics, not new untouched holdouts.
No aggregate portfolio returns, portfolio Sharpe or shared-capital account is constructed. Cross-ETF counts and medians summarize separate accounts only.
Annual and split samples are short and serially dependent; these diagnostics add no multiplicity correction or statistical significance.
Historical Sharpe changes can reflect exposure and cost differences; compare the recorded exposure, turnover, fees, drawdown and tail outcomes.
The causal always-long vol reference is the saved v2 benchmark with original weekly volatility sizing; it is not a new fit or optimized risk match.
